rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when putting air into a balloon, tyre, or other object.

example.english: The balloon is leaking air, so I need to inflate it again before my daughter can play with it.
example.traditional: 個氣球漏氣，我要再打氣先可以畀個女玩。
example.jyutping: go3 hei3 kau4 lau6 hei3 ngo5 jiu3 zoi3 daa2 hei3 sin1 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 neoi2 waan2

rows.note: Use this for something swelling or expanding, including someone becoming self-important, rather than for the ordinary act of pumping air into it.

example.english: As soon as the company had a little success, his ego began to inflate and he thought he was unbeatable.
example.traditional: 公司一有少少成績，佢就膨脹到以為自己天下無敵。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jat1 jau5 siu2 siu2 sing4 zik1 keoi5 zau6 paang4 zoeng3 dou3 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 tin1 haa6 mou4 dik6

rows.note: Use this when someone presents an importance, quality, or problem as greater than it really is.

example.english: They always inflate the seriousness of things, making everything sound like the end of the world.
example.traditional: 佢成日誇大件事，講到好似世界末日咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kwaa1 daai6 gin6 si6 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6 gam3
